source: ChainWard rug check QA run, Base, 2026-10-21 (34 tokens launched in the hours before; answers checked on chain). Launch receipts, funding transactions and point reads (vesting, Clanker extension balances) from mainnet.base.org; Uniswap v2 pair and factory logs from base.gateway.tenderly.co. Added for the QA gaps (2026-10-22): C7, C8 and D3 (launch receipts, the token Transfer logs from the launch to the QA head, the wallet the facts describe: its nonce and code then and a week before, its first funding transaction); their own launch transactions (C7 and C8 from Clanker TokenCreated logs, msgSender = the wallet; D3 from the QA run's Airlock launches, a 6-hour window); D6 and D8 transfers of the token from the first run's head to the second's; BOAT's vesting reads for the beneficiary its receipt names; the plain-deploy funders' latest sends as Basescan listed them at the QA snapshot, with one EXTCODEHASH read of their recipients at the block before the earliest send. Funders' other outgoing transfers were not recorded (keyless reads cannot list them) and read as none.
